blocks.text: You can integrate DSPM with Slack, a tool for centralized communication and collaboration. DSPM detects sensitive data or misconfigurations in the cloud resources and generates alerts. These alert notifications are sent to the configured Slack channels so you can investigate and address the issues on a common platform and streamline the mitigation directly into your developer tool.

Before integrating DSPM with Slack, you must set up the webhook on Slack. Incoming webhooks are used to post messages from the DSPM app to Slack. The incoming webhook provides a unique URL to which you send a JSON payload with the message text. To learn more, refer to the Slack documentation.

blocks.item: Log in to Slack.
Click Create an App, then select From scratch.
See image.
In the Name app & choose workspace window:
App Name: Enter a name for the app.
Pick a workspace to develop your app in: Select the Slack workspace from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Click Create App.
On the Basic Information page, select Incoming Webhooks.
See image.
On the Incoming Webhooks page:
Enable Activate Incoming Webhooks.
Click Add New Webhook to Workspace.
See image.
Select the Slack channel to which DSPM must send notifications, then click Allow.
See image.
Copy the Webhook URL. You must specify this URL when integrating DSPM with Slack.
You can add only one Webhook per Slack channel.
See image.
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > DSPM Integrations.
Click Add next to the ChatOps integration.
See image.
The Add ChatOps Integration page appears.
On the Add ChatOps Integration page, under Integration Details:
Integration Name: Enter a unique name for the integration.
Channel Name: Enter the name of the Slack channel where you want to receive alert notifications.
Webhook URL: Enter the webhook URL that you copied from the Slack portal. The URL allows DSPM to connect and communicate with the Slack channel.
Add More: Click to include additional channels where you want to receive alert notifications.
DSPM allows you to add 10 channels per integration. You can configure another integration to add more channels.
Test Connection: Click to verify the connection between DSPM and the Slack services. A message is displayed indicating the connection is verified. If not, then check the previous steps and try again.
See image.
Review the integration details on the Summary page.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: The Slack integration details are displayed on the Integrations page. To complete the integration process and enable data transmission, you must configure and associate the alert notification rules with this integration for DSPM to be able to send the data logs.
